d:
In the Bihar Assembly Election 2025, Tej Pratap Yadav, elder son of Lalu Prasad Yadav, is contesting from the Mahua Assembly seat. Interestingly, RJD has also fielded its own official candidate from the same constituency, creating political buzz across Bihar.
Our team reached Mahua to understand what the people really think about Tej Pratap Yadav and Tejashwi Yadav.
Is there a divide among RJD supporters? What do the voters of Mahua want this time?
